purpose: Teach: フォワード/グレート/ケルト/カルマ/ショッキング/悪者/ワニ/ひぐらし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サッカーのフォワード経験者だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was a forward in soccer, wasn't he?
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering—half to Aoi, half to herself. A gentle observation that lingers. Warm recall of a detail that caught her attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、グレート・ギャツビーの愛読者だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loves The Great Gatsby, he said.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Following Mei's lead, reflective but present. A small smile in the voice—noticing how Mei notices.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケルト音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer has a real love for Celtic music.
lines.style: Gentle, almost marveling at the detail. Slight pause before speaking, as if turning the thought over. Tender observation without urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨガでカルマの概念を教わったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer learned about karma through yoga, he told us.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. Taking in the depth of it. Slow, careful pacing—honoring what was shared. A thin thread of connection in her tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ショッキングな映画レビューを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really went deep on film—gave us quite a critique.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. A trace of amusement at the memory. Unhurried delivery, as if savoring the intensity of what he shared.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画の悪者キャラ論を熱く語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer got really animated talking about manga villains, remember?
lines.style: Warmer now, almost playful. A shared memory that softens her voice. Still reflective but with a hint of connection—noticing Aoi noticing too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、子供と動物園でワニを観たって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer went to the zoo with his child and saw a crocodile.
lines.style: Tender shift in delivery. Gentler still. The detail speaks to something—family, presence. Voice catches slightly on the kindness of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ひぐらしの鳴き声が好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told us he loves the sound of the evening cicadas.
lines.style: The softest moment yet. Almost reverent. Trailing off gently at the end, as if the image settles into silence. Closing a door on shared tenderness.
